content.name: Rohan Malhotra
content.title: Enterprise Account Executive
content.summary: Enterprise account executive with 14 years in B2B technology sales, including networking, cloud and HR software, to Indian conglomerates and BFSI companies. Manages strategic accounts worth ₹62 crore in annual contract value and has led five deals above ₹10 crore.

experience.title: Enterprise Account Executive (Strategic Accounts)
bullets: Own 11 strategic accounts in BFSI and manufacturing with ₹62 crore in combined annual contract value.
Closed a ₹18 crore, three-year HRMS contract for 85,000 employees at a private bank after a 10-month evaluation with HR, IT and information security.
Achieved 126% of the annual new-business target in FY 2024-25, the highest in the North India team.
Brought in implementation partners early on large bids so timelines and payroll compliance (PF, ESI, TDS) were agreed before signing.
Mentor four account executives and run the weekly North region pipeline review.

experience.title: Senior Account Executive
bullets: Sold data centre and private cloud services to large enterprises in Delhi NCR, growing my book from ₹14 crore to ₹31 crore.
Won a ₹12 crore disaster recovery contract with an insurance company by aligning the proposal with IRDAI outsourcing guidelines.
Responded to 30+ public and private sector tenders, maintaining a 38% win rate.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold email, collaboration and backup subscriptions to mid-sized companies, signing around 60 new logos a year.
Ran CXO breakfast sessions in Gurugram and Noida that generated ₹4 crore in pipeline.
Exceeded quota in all four years and was promoted to senior AE.

experience.title: Sales Executive
bullets: Sold routers, switches and structured cabling projects to schools and small offices across West Delhi.
Prepared technical quotes with pre-sales engineers and tracked payments to keep receivables under 45 days.
Closed ₹1.2 crore in orders in my first year before leaving for full-time PGDM study.

education.school: Delhi College of Engineering (now Delhi Technological University)

achievements.title: Largest HRMS contract
achievements.detail: ₹18 crore contract covering 85,000 employees, the company's biggest single deal.

achievements.title: Five ₹10 crore+ deals
achievements.detail: Led five enterprise deals above ₹10 crore across two companies.
